notes: Budget of 30 fetches fully used. 4 HN calls failed with a malformed filter (400) and were rerun; HN 'visa developer' not rerun. GitHub search hit the unauthenticated rate limit on the second call; the first returned mainly pull requests in integrator repos (juspay/hyperswitch, mitodl), which are not coded as sentiment. Reddit old.reddit JSON returned an HTML block page for all three subs. cybersource developer community and the Medium guide returned 403. Queries not run within budget: '<visa> certification', '<visa> onboarding', '<visa> support', and dev.to/LinkedIn/PSR/RBA/Congressional searches. VAMP (acquirer/merchant), DOJ v. Visa debit routing (Interlink), and National ATM Council ATM access-fee litigation were located only through search-engine summaries, with no verbatim quote from a named partner, so they are left out of items; they are leads for a follow-up pass. HN visa-API results were dominated by immigration-visa noise. Stack Overflow items are help requests; coded critical where the poster reports failure against the official docs or sandbox, but they measure integration friction, not overall opinion. No favourable developer item was found, so developer balance could not be met. Wayback returned no snapshot for the 3 URLs checked; the rest were not checked (archive_url null).
